composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Runs first: an already-seen Idempotency-Key replays the original owner (200) before the
# duplicate-identity check would reject the repeat (409).
checkIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotency
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: validate

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureCityCapacity

ensureCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureDailyLimit

ensureDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureDailyLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureUniqueIdentity

# Single consolidated duplicate check: the whole identityKey
# (normalizedTelephone|email|householdId) must not match an existing owner. Runs after
# assignHousehold so the householdId component of the key is set.
ensureUniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdSize

assignHouseholdSize:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdSize
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMemberId

assignMemberId:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMemberId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMembershipLevel

# Runs after householdSize and namesakeCount are set (both feed the level), and before save so the
# new owner is not counted among its own existing household members.
assignMembershipLevel:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignBulkSignupWarning

assignBulkSignupWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignPossibleDuplicate

assignPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCapacityWarning

assignCapacityWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCapacityWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: recordIdempotency

# Owner now has a generated id: remember it against the Idempotency-Key (no-op when absent).
recordIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotency
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: emitEvent

emitEvent:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EmitOwnerCreatedEvent
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: notifyWelcome

notifyWelcome:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnqueueWelcomeNotification
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. When supplied it is combined with the lastName to form the salutation."
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when the structured addressLine1 is supplied it is preferred. Returned as the composed, normalized address (normalized addressLine1, plus a space and the normalized addressLine2 when addressLine2 is present)."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: "The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; a non-blank addressLine1 satisfies the address requirement. Stored and returned normalized."
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: "The optional second line of the structured postal address. When present it is normalized and appended (after a single space) to the composed 'address'."
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "A 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When supplied it must be valid for the owner's city per a fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given."
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it is stored and used to derive the ageBand (computed against the registrationDate). Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner has the same lastName and address (they share a household). Request-only; not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, formed as '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation formatted as '<title> <lastName>' when a title was supplied, or just the lastName when no title is given."
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the '+'-prefixed country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Raw 'telephone' stays E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The owner's unified member id formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>', where REGION is the region code derived from the postcode, FY is the two-digit fiscal year of the registrationDate, HASH8 is the first eight upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone + lastName), and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier assigned to owners who share a household (same lastName and address), created via sharesHousehold. All owners in one household carry the same value; null for owners not part of a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived duplicate-detection key, formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + (householdId or empty). A create request whose whole identityKey equals an existing owner's is rejected with 409. Because the telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with different telephones have different identity keys.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>', where the fiscal year starts on 1 July and YY is the last two digits of the calendar year in which it began. Null when registrationDate is absent.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "The owner's membership points: start at 0, add 2 when an email is present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, add 2 for a household of 3 or more, add 3 for a tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "A numeric level from 1 to 4 mapped from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, 4 for 6 or more."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created on the current business day at the moment this owner was created, signalling a possible bulk-signup event; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners at the moment this owner was created, signalling that the city is approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: True when this owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id}; the record is retained and still returned by GET. A newly created owner is false. Deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode while having a different telephone, signalling a soft match; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches on lastName and postcode; null when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region derived from the city via a fixed table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The IANA timezone name derived from the locality/region via a fixed table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane); null when the region is not in the table."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Null when birthDate is absent."
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: "The owner's marketing segment formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'."
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
